description: React component for a file preview modal, including file navigation, renaming, options menu, and linked items display.

classes.name: FilePreviewModal
classes.description: React observer component for displaying a modal with file preview, options, and navigation.

classes.name: FilePreviewModalWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper component that renders the modal overlay and the FilePreviewModal component.

methods.name: keyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation and dismiss actions within the modal.

methods.name: handleRename
methods.description: Renames the current file if a new name is provided.

methods.name: toggleOptionsMenu
methods.description: Toggles the display of the file options menu.

methods.name: toggleInfoPanel
methods.description: Toggles the display of the file info panel.

methods.name: toggleLinkedBubblesContainer
methods.description: Toggles the display of linked items container.
